evidence.reason: Changed evaluate call from (minutes, 0.1, "work") to (minutes, 0, "benchmark") and returns undefined identifier 'valu' instead of 'value', breaking the caller contract exercised by test/reminders.test.mjs scheduledDelay(40).
Swapped priorities from [multiplier, multiplier/2] to [multiplier/2, multiplier], changing the floor term for every caller including evaluate, which the test evaluate(20, 0.1, "work") relies on.
Test asserts evaluate(20, 0.1, "work") > 0 and scheduledDelay(40) > 0, both of which depend on the original multiplier/calendar arguments and priorities ordering.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动分别破坏了 scheduledDelay 的调用参数与返回值，并改变了 reminderDelay 的优先级顺序，合并后行为与既有测试所依赖的语义不一致，需人工确认。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/scheduling.ts#scheduledDelay 的作者恢复 evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "work") 并修正返回值为 value；同时请 src/reminders.ts#reminderDelay 的作者确认 priorities 顺序是否应保持 [multiplier, multiplier/2]。
